decisions.evidence: Putting the six neighbors together, the three positive neighbors and the three negative neighbors all show the same broad pattern: the query does retain an alkyl chloride feature that can be associated with mutagenicity, but it is consistently smaller, less ringed, and less heteroatom-rich than the mutagenic analogs, while also matching or exceeding some of the not-mutagenic analogs on compactness and saturation-related descriptors. The balance of evidence across all six comparisons therefore favors option (A): is not mutagenic.
